threads.body: The comment indicates this version must match the `google_checks.xml` basis for the configuration, but the PR only bumps `toolVersion`. If `buildscripts/checkstyle.xml` was derived from a specific `google_checks.xml` version, consider adding a short note (or link/constant) documenting which upstream `google_checks.xml` revision/version it matches so future bumps can be validated and kept in sync.
